baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative chain at 22:77 moves from bowing and prostrating through serving the Lord to doing the good, then ends in hoped-for flourishing.
baseline_models.mechanism: A progressive bodily descent becomes durable allegiance, then exits the ritual body as beneficial work; flourishing is the hoped-for durability of that integrated posture and practice.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent names addressees whose inward trust is to become embodied obedience.
Bending and lowering the head begins the literal downward movement.
Full lowering and submission intensify bodily descent into yieldedness.
Obedient worship converts momentary posture into sustained allegiance.
Lordship and sovereignty supply the relation governing the service.
Actually bringing a work about carries inward and bodily submission into effects.
Beneficial, sound good qualifies the effects the action must produce.
Victory, survival, and remaining in good supply the hoped-for durable outcome.

changed_reading.before: A list of separate ritual and ethical commands followed by a promise of success.
changed_reading.after: One continuous conversion of trusted assent into lowered embodiment, loyal service, beneficial agency, and durable flourishing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of the nurturing Lord, doing the good, and falah allows the final clause to retain the root's cutting and husbandry images alongside success.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord repairs and raises by degrees; the servants answer by making beneficial effects. Falah then figures the hoped outcome as resistant ground opened and worked until it can bear lasting good.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and gradual completion make lordship an ongoing formative process.
The split mapped image of nourishment and growth exposes the cultivation latent in being raised by the Lord.
Effective making gives the cultivated recipients an active tending role.
Benefit and soundness identify the yield sought from that tending.
Splitting and opening supply the material first stage of cultivation.
The plougher who cuts earth turns flourishing into labor upon a resistant medium.
Lasting victory preserves the ordinary success sense as the cultivation's yield.

changed_reading.before: Worship and good deeds are conditions for an externally awarded success.
changed_reading.after: Divine nurture and human good-making form a cultivation circuit in which flourishing is both the opening labor and its enduring yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Those addressed as believers are immediately told to bend, submit, serve their sovereign Lord, and release good before flourishing is even possible.
baseline_models.mechanism: The securely trusting are not allowed to turn security into self-sufficiency: bowing activates a fall from wealth into need, service acknowledges ownership, and generous good redirects held advantage outward.

activation_trace.role: Security, trust, and entrustedness define the addressees' starting condition.
The branch of becoming poor after wealth makes bowing a surprising status reversal rather than posture alone.
The ownership relation strips away the servant's claim to autonomous possession.
Sovereign ownership locates security under the Lord rather than in retained status.
Generosity and gift make good the outward release of advantage.
Flourishing becomes survival in good after self-sufficiency has been relinquished.

changed_reading.before: Already secure believers add devotional acts and charity to their standing.
changed_reading.after: Belief is tested by a downward status conversion: entrusted security flourishes only when sovereignty is conceded and advantage becomes gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dormant-earth sequence supplies a material process for the focus's cultivation model: lowered earth receives, stirs, rises, sprouts, and greens. Doing good participates in preparing and tending the medium, while the Lord remains the giver of growth.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and gradual completion anchor growth in the Lord named by the focus.
The plougher's earth-opening work anchors the agricultural change in the focus's hoped-for falah.
Soft, growth-bearing earth supplies the receptive medium of the mechanism.
Dry lifelessness marks the medium's initial incapacity and the scale of change.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies the first visible activation.
Increase and rising provide the growth phase after reception and stirring.
Vegetation emerging from earth gives the process an outward yield.
Fresh green growth confirms that the sequence culminates in living fruitfulness.

structural_cues: 22:5 orders dormant earth, received water, movement, swelling, and growth; 22:63 repeats the descent of water and the earth's greening.
The focus itself places doing beneficial good immediately before falah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the earth-growth sequence and falah's ploughing branch; I infer an ethical cultivation arrow from good action to prepared ground and durable yield. A live alternative is that the earth sequence functions only as resurrection evidence and does not model human action.

changed_reading.before: Falah is the successful result received after worship and good action.
changed_reading.after: Falah is also cultivated emergence: good action opens and tends resistant ground within a life-giving process whose growth comes from the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The conditional worshipper settles when good arrives but turns away under trial and incurs loss. Against that sequence, 22:77 reads as training a stable allegiance in which worship and good-making continue independently of immediate gain.

activation_trace.role: Sustained obedient worship anchors the counter-model in the focus.
The same worship branch enters a conditional sequence and exposes allegiance that depends on outcome.
Received benefit is the condition that temporarily stabilizes the edge-worshipper.
Inclining away from a direction turns the edge into a mechanism of unstable orientation.
Settling and tranquility show that immediate benefit can produce only contingent stability.
Turning a thing onto its face supplies the reversal when conditions worsen.
Commercial loss frames transactional devotion as a failed exchange.

structural_cues: 22:11 binds worship, received good, temporary settling, trial, face-turning, and loss in a single conditional chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unstable conditional worship; I infer that 22:77's uninterrupted imperatives answer it by habituating nontransactional fidelity. A live alternative is simple contrast rather than a deliberate corrective relation.

changed_reading.before: The commands are means by which believers may obtain flourishing.
changed_reading.after: The commands dismantle outcome-dependent worship: flourishing names stable fidelity and beneficial action across gain and trial, not a bargain for favorable conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated prostration expands outward in two directions: it joins the addressees to a cosmos already lowered to God, and it locates bowing and prostration among people gathered at a purified house. The focus's body sequence is therefore both cosmic alignment and shared-space practice.

activation_trace.role: Literal bending anchors the repeated posture in the focus.
Lowering and submission anchor the model's common bodily relation.
The same lowering branch is predicated across the verse's vast created field, widening the posture's scale.
Dwelling and shelter give the repeated postures a maintained communal locus.
Removing ugliness from self and work makes purification functional preparation for worshippers.
Humble bowing identifies the human community occupying that prepared locus.
The place-of-prostration image fuses posture with the space made ready for it.

structural_cues: 22:18 distributes prostration across heavens, earth, celestial bodies, terrain, vegetation, animals, and people.
22:26 repeats bowing and prostration after the command to purify the House.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated posture at cosmic and sanctuary scales; I infer that the focus calls believers to join and maintain that alignment. A live alternative keeps involuntary cosmic submission distinct from prescribed human ritual.

changed_reading.before: Bowing and prostrating are private devotional acts preceding ethical work.
changed_reading.after: They enroll the body in a creation-wide submission while making the worshipper responsible for a purified shared locus from which good action proceeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ritual passages repeatedly route provision outward to the poor, the contented, and the arriving seeker, while denying that flesh or blood itself reaches God. Thus doing the good becomes a transfer mechanism: ritual matter becomes human nourishment, expenditure, and excellent action rather than sacred consumption by God.

activation_trace.role: Effective doing anchors the demanded transfer in actual work.
Benefit and soundness make the recipients' good a criterion of action.
Feeding another converts ritual provision into direct material benefit.
Need and lack identify a concrete recipient rather than an abstract virtue.
The outward passage of wealth generalizes redistribution beyond one ritual occasion.
Contentment ensures that quiet need remains visible within the recipient field.
One who comes seeking or lodging adds the visibly arriving claimant to that field.
Reaching and attaining organize the explicit contrast over what does and does not reach God.
Doing what is beautiful and sound names the human agent formed by the transfer.

structural_cues: 22:28 and 22:36 repeat commands to feed named human recipients from ritual animals.
22:37 contrasts flesh and blood with the inward quality that reaches God, then names doers of excellence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies redistribution and the reach/non-reach contrast; I infer that these concretize the focus's good as benefit transferred through ritual rather than ritual material retained. A live alternative treats them as local sacrifice rules rather than a wider account of al-khayr.

changed_reading.before: Do the good is an open-ended command to virtuous conduct after worship.
changed_reading.after: Within worship, good is already material and relational: provision must leave the rite, reach differentiated human need, and form the giver as a doer of excellence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith as security becomes a public trust. Defensive power prevents the collapse of multiple worship spaces; when believers gain capacity, its proper outputs are established prayer, purifying increase, recognized good, and restraint of repellent wrong. Doing good therefore includes institutions that keep worship and social benefit possible.

activation_trace.role: Security and entrustedness anchor the public-trust reading in the focus's addressees.
Public arrangements remain answerable to actual benefit and soundness.
Driving harm away supplies protection rather than domination as power's first function.
The defended believers connect protection back to the same security-bearing identity addressed in the focus.
Repelling harm becomes a mechanism preventing the destruction that follows in the verse.
A building cast down supplies the concrete loss that defensive action averts.
The Christian worship-place branch makes protected worship explicitly broader than the addressees' own rite.
Places and houses of prayer extend the protected field across worshipping communities.
Capacity and empowerment introduce the test of what believers do with public power.
Growth and increase make obligatory giving a public circulation of flourishing.
Recognized good supplies a socially discernible norm rather than private preference.
Restraint from action supplies the blocking side of public ethical responsibility.
Repellent wrong identifies what communal restraint is directed against.

structural_cues: 22:38-40 move from defending believers to preventing demolition of several named kinds of worship space.
22:41 tests empowerment by prayer, giving, recognized good, and restraint of wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, threatened worship spaces, empowerment, and public practices; I infer that these are institutional forms of the focus's entrusted good. A live alternative reads 22:41 as signs of just rule without making them an expansion of 22:77.

changed_reading.before: Believers bow, worship, and perform individually beneficial deeds.
changed_reading.after: Secure believers carry a civic trust: protect the conditions of worship, circulate growth, and use power to sustain recognizable benefit and block recognizable harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse places full exertion beside the denial of constriction and ends with gripping God as protecting patron and helper. The focus's downward postures become a technology of dependence: demanding service is bearable because agency is attached to a preserving support rather than sealed inside the self.

activation_trace.role: Bodily bending begins the focus's relinquishment of self-standing posture.
Deep lowering makes dependence embodied rather than merely asserted.
Obedient service supplies the durable practice whose demand must be explained.
Expending one's capacity under difficulty intensifies the command sequence into sustained exertion.
Obedience and yielding identify the domain in which exertion occurs.
Constriction and tightness name precisely what is denied within that demanding domain.
Holding that prevents and preserves supplies the support that keeps exertion from becoming enclosure.
A patron who takes charge gives the holding relation active governance.
Aid and making manifest supply outward help rather than isolated self-exertion.

structural_cues: 22:78 juxtaposes maximal striving, no constriction in the obedient way, holding fast to God, patronage, and aid.
Its final imperatives continue the imperative cadence begun in 22:77.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies effort, denied tightness, preserving grip, patronage, and aid; I infer a causal arrow from supported dependence to nonconstricting exertion. A live alternative is that no-constriction states legal ease while striving remains a separate demand.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a demanding ascent from bodily worship to successful action.
changed_reading.after: Its demand is a supported descent into dependence: strenuous service remains spacious because worshippers hold to the patron who preserves and helps them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Selection places the addressees on an inherited, repeatedly traveled way and assigns them reciprocal witness. Prayer and purifying distribution become publicly legible evidence; the focus's good is not only private benefit but a practice through which a community can truthfully be seen.

activation_trace.role: Trusted assent anchors communal witness in a claim that must become credible.
Actual effects give witness observable content rather than verbal identity alone.
Benefit and soundness constrain what can count as credible public evidence.
Choosing and drawing near establish vocation rather than self-appointment.
A road made recognizable by repeated travel turns inherited tradition into practiced continuity.
Fatherhood and upbringing give the inherited way a formative lineage.
Presence with direct observation makes witness a public relation between messenger, community, and people.
Specified worship gives the inherited witness a repeated embodied form.
Growth and increase make giving the distributive form paired with public prayer.

structural_cues: 22:78 moves from selection and Abrahamic lineage to reciprocal witness, then immediately commands prayer and giving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen lineage, witness, prayer, and giving; I infer that the last two enact the witness and specify the focus's public good. A live alternative is that they are adjacent summary duties without an evidentiary function.

changed_reading.before: The focus addresses believers as individuals who should worship and do good.
changed_reading.after: It commissions a formed community whose embodied worship and circulating good must make inherited trust publicly witnessable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the fabricated-making and deceptive-market branches of two ordinary focus words. It remains anchored in فعل, خير, and فلح and gains contextual pressure from transactional loss, false speech, removal, and tightening; downstream prose should present it only as an anti-counterfeit resonance, never as a replacement translation of تفلحون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of 'do,' 'the good,' and 'flourish' can expose the difference between genuinely beneficial action and a manufactured performance of success.

activation_trace.role: Contrived fabrication shadows doing with the possibility of a made-up performance.
Actual benefit and soundness provide the internal test that limits fabricated action.
Embellishing a sale and deceptive dealing make counterfeit flourishing a live shadow of the success clause.
Commercial loss gives outcome-dependent worship a transactional register.
Falsehood and invalid speech supply an explicit counterfeit that must be avoided.
Removal followed by replacement supplies a filtering operation on inserted material.
Tightening, perfecting, and securing provide the positive endpoint of authentication.

changed_reading.before: Perform good in order to attain success.
changed_reading.after: Perform benefit that survives authentication, because both 'doing' and apparent 'success' can be staged, embellished, or transactionally counterfeited.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is unusually mapping-distant: the packet's non-dominant فعل target meets the explicit father-root in 22:78. The shared root ID, the focus's nurturing Lord, and the inherited Abrahamic way keep it traceable; downstream prose should call it a generative or parental analogy, not claim that افعلوا lexically means fathering.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's split inventory lets the command to do good carry a remote image of parent-like generation and nurture.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped image of fatherhood and nurture makes good action generative rather than episodic.
The Lord's repair and gradual upbringing supply the formative pattern such action imitates.
Explicit fatherhood and upbringing in the inherited line reactivate the focus's remote mapped branch.
The repeatedly traveled inherited path gives generative action continuity across generations.

changed_reading.after: Generate and raise durable good in others, extending a formative inheritance rather than merely accumulating isolated acts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The sustained-gaze branch of سجود is peripheral to ordinary prostration, so the perceptual mechanism is surprising. It remains anchored in the commanded prostration and the context's explicit distinction between eyes and heart-perception; downstream prose should render it as an attentional resonance, not redefine the rite as a visual exercise.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Prostration's branch of lowered, sustained looking can make the bodily sequence a recalibration of perception before action.

activation_trace.role: Sustained looking with lowered, quiet eyes supplies the unusual attentional posture.
Effective action makes recalibrated attention consequential rather than contemplative only.
Blindness of heart and insight relocates failed perception inward.
Heart-insight supplies the positive faculty that bodily looking alone cannot guarantee.
The heart provides the organ whose orientation the lowered gaze may discipline.

changed_reading.before: Prostration is bodily submission before the command to act.
changed_reading.after: Prostration may also quiet and lower outward seeing so inward discernment can govern what good is actually done.

strongest_changes: Falah changed from an abstract reward into cultivated emergence: earth is opened, stirred, raised, and made fruitful under divine nurture.
Doing the good became materially and publicly testable through feeding, expenditure, protection of worship spaces, and accountable use of power.
The adjacent closing verse reframed the command chain as strenuous but nonconstricting dependence and as an inherited public witness.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several mechanisms without collapsing them: bodily descent becomes action, cultivation coexists with durable victory, private worship becomes redistribution and civic protection, and distant branches preserve warnings about counterfeit success, generative action, and inward sight.
remaining_uncertainties: The ethical arrow drawn from earth revival to cultivation is abductive; resurrection remains the strongest independent function of those scenes.
Cosmic prostration and prescribed human prostration may be analogous without belonging to one operational mechanism.
The parental فعل mapping, marketplace فلح branch, and perceptual سجود branch are deliberately retained but remain too distant for unqualified prose.
